outputs.title: Manage outputs
outputs.description: {count} switch/text outputs. Shared limit with notifications: {limit} entries. Enabled targets execute real actions.

output_add.title: Choose output type and target
output_add.description: Choose a switch, short-text or long-text output. Notifications have a separate main menu.

output_details.title: Configure output
output_details.description: Configure switch/text values for alarm, acknowledgement and idle. Enabled targets are actually controlled.

data_description.name: Also used for the local output status entity.
data_description.entity_id: Text without a target only updates the local status entity. Switch outputs require a target.
data_description.enabled: Check values and rule assignments before enabling.

alarm.name: When active
alarm.description: Value when at least one active alarm requests this output.

data_description.alarm_value: Text placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status; e.g. {beispiel}. Short text up to 14 bytes, long text up to 4096 characters; target limits also apply.

acknowledged.name: After acknowledgement
acknowledged.description: Value when requesting alarms are acknowledged.

data_description.acknowledged_value: Text placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status; e.g. {beispiel}. Short text up to 14 bytes, long text up to 4096 characters; target limits also apply.

idle.name: When idle / after reset
idle.description: Idle value for targets previously controlled by this integration. No blanket switching at startup.

data_description.idle_value: Text placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status; e.g. {beispiel}. Short text up to 14 bytes, long text up to 4096 characters; target limits also apply.

format.name: Short-text format
format.description: Choose the encoding required by the target.

data_description.encoding: 14 bytes are not always 14 characters. Unrepresentable characters produce an error.

status.title: Status & overview

notification_add.title: Choose notification type
notification_add.description: Choose an HA app/Pushover notification or browser pop-up. Choose devices in the next step.

notification_details.title: Configure notification
notification_details.description: Set title, recipients and messages. A rejected reset sends its reason. The browser pop-up acknowledgement button acknowledges only the shown alarms and displays the saved result.

data_description.name: Also used for the local output status entity.
data_description.enabled: Check values and rule assignments before enabling.

alarm.name: When active
alarm.description: Value when at least one active alarm requests this output.

data_description.alarm_value: Up to 1024 characters after substitution. Placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status, e.g. {beispiel}. Empty = no regular phase message. Reset errors and pop-up acknowledgement results are still displayed.

acknowledged.name: After acknowledgement
acknowledged.description: When the alarm is acknowledged. New entries have a useful default message.

data_description.acknowledged_value: Up to 1024 characters after substitution. Placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status, e.g. {beispiel}. Empty = no regular phase message. Reset errors and pop-up acknowledgement results are still displayed.

idle.name: When idle / after reset
idle.description: After a successful reset. A rejected reset reports the specific error instead.

data_description.idle_value: Up to 1024 characters after substitution. Placeholders: regel, quelle, bereich, alarmtyp, status, e.g. {beispiel}. Empty = no regular phase message. Reset errors and pop-up acknowledgement results are still displayed.

delivery.name: Devices & message
delivery.description: Choose recipients explicitly. For one phone, choose its app entity OR its legacy action. Tablet overlays require Browser Mod connected in the open dashboard.

data_description.routes: Multiple selection. No all-browser option. Saved unavailable destinations are labelled.
data_description.title: Up to 80 characters after placeholder substitution, e.g. {beispiel}.

pushover.name: Pushover (optional)
pushover.description: Use only with a selected Pushover destination.

data_description.devices: Pushover only: exact device names separated by commas without spaces. Empty = all devices of this Pushover account. HA does not expose these account devices in its device picker.
data_description.priority: Pushover only. Emergency repeating alerts are not enabled in this version.

group_move.title: Move detector
group_move.description: Moves the detector to the selected group. Automatic all-detector groups retain it.

group_remove.title: Delete group
group_remove.description: Remove group references from rules first. Built-in groups cannot be deleted.

discovery.title: Automatically enroll smoke detectors

house_discovery.title: Automatically enroll house alarm buttons

data.house_pattern: Name or entity ID pattern (e.g. event.house_alarm_*)
data.house_trigger: Button event type or trigger state

house_discovery.description: Provide a specific name pattern or label ID. If both are set, both must match. Example: event.house_alarm_* with event type single. The MQTT/Zigbee integration must expose suitable HA entities; event types depend on the device. Enabling this creates or updates the all-house-alarm-buttons rule with the selected targets.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
error.invalid_state: Use 1 to 255 characters; unknown and unavailable are not trigger states.
error.entity_not_found: This entity does not exist. Select an existing entity.
error.own_entity: This integration's own sensors cannot be input sources.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm removal or cancel the dialog.
error.choose_inputs: Select at least one input without duplicates.
error.unknown_input: A selected input no longer exists. Check the selection.
error.input_in_use: This input is still used by rules. Edit or remove those rules first.
error.invalid_output_target: Target entity does not match the output type.
error.output_target_required: Select a target entity for a switch output.
error.duplicate_output_target: An output for this target already exists. Share that output between rules or edit it.
error.invalid_template: Use only the listed simple placeholders; check braces and spelling.
error.text_too_long: Use at most 4096 characters and no null characters.
error.short_text_invalid: Enter short text without line breaks.
error.short_text_too_long: Short text exceeds 14 bytes. Shorten it; rendered placeholders are checked at runtime too.
error.unsupported_character: Text contains characters outside the chosen encoding.
error.output_in_use: This output is still assigned to rules. Remove those assignments first.
error.output_owned: This target is still controlled by the integration. Reset the alarm or disable the output and wait for the idle value to be confirmed.
error.invalid_notification: Check recipient selection, title and Pushover settings. Select at least one matching destination.
error.notification_too_long: Shorten the message to 1024 characters; title up to 80 characters after substitution.
error.group_in_use: This group is in use or is a protected built-in group.
error.invalid_house_discovery: Check the discovery pattern/label, trigger and at least one alarm target.
error.choose_discovery_targets: Select at least one output or notification. Create these first if necessary.

abort.invalid_configuration: Inputs, rules or outputs are invalid or from a newer version. Nothing was overwritten; check logs and backup.
abort.configuration_changed: Configuration changed while this dialog was open. Please reopen it.
abort.max_inputs: Maximum of ten inputs. Remove an input first.
abort.no_inputs_for_rules: First add at least one input under Input sources.
abort.max_rules: Maximum of 30 rules. Remove a rule first.
abort.no_rules: No rules yet. Add a rule to begin.
abort.max_outputs: Shared limit of 20 outputs and notifications reached.
abort.group_member_in_use: This item still belongs to a group. Remove its membership first.
